verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists "Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)" as a feature, so first-party material confirms MSI-based mass deployment. That is a single feature-list line, with no deployment documentation behind it. missing for 10: evidence of preset configuration applied at deploy time, documented silent-install switches or parameters, MDM-based client deployment, in-depth deployment docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
